name: 李凤，Feng Li
faculty_intro: 教授，实验室负责人。主要围绕核酸功能材料、精准诊疗与生物界面调控开展研究。
faculty_intro_en: Professor and laboratory head. Research focuses on functional nucleic acid materials, precision diagnosis and treatment, and biological interface regulation.

name: 董宇航，Yuhang Dong
faculty_intro: 董宇航，博士，北京化工大学化学学院讲师。分别于2017年和2022年在天津大学获学士学位和博士学位，2022年以博士后进入北京化工大学化学学院工作。研究方向为核酸化学、核酸纳米药物创制，以及新型药物递送系统的构建和生物医学研究。近年来，以通讯/第一作者在J. Am. Chem. Soc.、Angew. Chem. Int. Ed.、Chem. Rev.、Chem. Soc. Rev.、Nano Today、Adv. Funct. Mater.等期刊发表论文20余篇，申请发明专利11项，主持国家级、省部级等基金项目5项。现任Advanced Clinical Engineering、Chinese Chemical Letters期刊的青年编委。主讲《分析化学》、《核酸化学与材料》等课程。
faculty_intro_en: Yuhang Dong, Ph.D., is a lecturer in the College of Chemistry at Beijing University of Chemical Technology. He received his bachelor's and doctoral degrees from Tianjin University in 2017 and 2022, respectively, and joined the College of Chemistry at Beijing University of Chemical Technology as a postdoctoral researcher in 2022. His research focuses on nucleic acid chemistry, the development of nucleic acid nanomedicines, and the construction and biomedical investigation of novel drug delivery systems. In recent years, he has published more than 20 papers as a corresponding or first author in journals including J. Am. Chem. Soc., Angew. Chem. Int. Ed., Chem. Rev., Chem. Soc. Rev., Nano Today, and Adv. Funct. Mater. He has filed 11 invention patent applications and led five national, provincial, and ministerial research projects. He currently serves as a young editorial board member for Advanced Clinical Engineering and Chinese Chemical Letters. He teaches Analytical Chemistry and Nucleic Acid Chemistry and Materials.
